CRISP_WEBSITE_ID.description: Crisp never calls it public. It is public here because its only job is to sit in the chatbox script that ships to every visitor.

CRISP_IDENTIFIER.description: Half of the API token pair, which is a different credential from the website id above. Crisp says to keep the pair private at any time.

CRISP_KEY.description: The secret half. Crisp says a leak could result in the data of every website that installed your plugin being dumped, which is the widest blast radius stated in this batch.
